summary: Dell Alienware X17 R1 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Intermittent blue screen errors (BSOD) when closing and opening laptop lid, specifically when using MUX feature to render graphics on the screen.
suggested_solution: Roll back GPU drivers to a previous revision
Install latest official Dell driver from support site and use NVCleanInstall with Platform Controller option checked
Perform clean install of drivers using DDU
